description: 1 seed (8 MiB/s up) and 20 downloaders (1 MiB/s up each, 10–59 ms latency) joining within 2 s; 64 MiB file, 256 KiB pieces. Downloaders upload to each other.
As flash-crowd, but the only seed leaves after 12 s (time to upload ~1.5 copies). Downloaders can only finish if, between them, they hold every piece.
4 seeds with very different upload capacity and latency (16 MiB/s·5 ms, 4 MiB/s·20 ms, 1 MiB/s·50 ms, 0.25 MiB/s·200 ms) serving 4 downloaders that do not upload; 64 MiB file.
As heterogeneous-seeds, but the fastest seed leaves after 2 s.
